channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Chipotle: Free Chips and Guac for National Avocado Day
item.guid: Chipotle-Free Chips and Guac for National Avocado-2026-07-31
item.description: Use code AVO2026 at checkout in the Chipotle app or website with any entree purchase to get a free regular side of chips and guacamole, July 31 and August 1 only. Free account required. (Through August 1, 2026)

item.title: Del Taco: BOGO Epic Fresh Guac Burritos for National Avocado Day
item.guid: Del Taco-BOGO Epic Fresh Guac Burritos for Nation-2026-07-31
item.description: Buy one Epic Fresh Guac Burrito and get a second one free at Del Taco, running July 30 through August 2 in celebration of National Avocado Day. (Through August 2, 2026)

item.title: Domino's: 50% Off All Menu-Priced Pizzas
item.description: Get half off every menu-priced pizza in any size, crust, and topping combination including Specialty Pizzas, for delivery or carryout ordered online, via the app, by phone, or in person through August 2. (Through August 2, 2026)

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu
item.description: Get three pieces of chicken, two sides, or a chicken sandwich for just $5 via the Popeyes app or online order through August 31, 2026. (Through August 31, 2026)

item.title: Wendy's: Biggie Deals Value Bundle in App
item.guid: Wendy's-Biggie Deals Value Bundle in App-2026-07-31
item.description: Grab Wendy's app for daily Biggie Deals including a four-item combo for $6 or a two-sandwich Biggie Bundle for $8, available every day. (Ongoing)

item.title: Burger King: $5 Your Way Meal
item.description: Order a $5 Your Way Meal daily through the Burger King app, combining a sandwich, fries, and drink at a bundled price. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: $5.99 Footlong with Code FL599
item.description: Use promo code FL599 in the Subway app to get a Footlong sub for $5.99 at participating locations; availability varies by zip code. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Sweetgreen: Alice Waters' Peach & Goat Cheese Salad
item.description: Limited-edition summer collab with chef Alice Waters - a seasonal peach & goat cheese salad available nationwide in-app and in stores, with 1% of proceeds donated to the Edible Schoolyard Project. (Through August 10, 2026)
